name: digital-companion
description: A little desktop pet that wanders around your screen. Pick him up, throw him, pet him.
author: Sushant Patil

scripts.dist: node scripts/fetch-models.js && node scripts/build-helpers.js && node scripts/clean-dist.js && electron-builder --mac --dir && node scripts/sign.js
scripts.creator: node dev/server.js

extendInfo.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Filo reads your upcoming events so it can remind you before meetings and keep quiet during them. Nothing leaves your Mac.
extendInfo.NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: Filo reads your upcoming events so it can remind you before meetings and keep quiet during them. Nothing leaves your Mac.
extendInfo.NSAppleEventsUsageDescription: Filo checks which app is in front so it can keep quiet during meetings and know what you're working on. Nothing leaves your Mac.
extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Filo listens only after you press ⌥ Space or 🎤 to talk to it, and only until you stop talking, so it can do what you ask.
extendInfo.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Filo turns what you say to it into text on your Mac, so it can do what you ask.
